newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian welfare must be changed not cut - Prodi.
newsitem.headline: Italian welfare must be changed not cut - Prodi.

text.p: Spending on the welfare state should be re-weighted towards younger people but not cut, Prime Minister Romano Prodi said in a speech to a congress of the Democratic Party of the Left (PDS).
"Social spending has to be defended at all costs but should be orientated towards the young," Prodi said. "My government will never entirely entrust the market with the health of its citizens."
The hardleft Communist Refoundation has warned that if Prodi tried to cut back on state spending in the forthcoming mini-budget it would be unable to secure the government's majority in parliament.

Economists have urged the government to slash back spending on bloated state pensions and Prodi has said he plans to launch an overview of the system before the end of the year. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
